column1: # Svelte components, read through their <script> blocks (internal/parse/sfc.go).
# Lines are lines of the .svelte file. A definition is:
#   the component itself: the file name, as a class at line 1 (not for +page.svelte and other
#     names that are routes or companions);
#   function, class, interface, type, enum and method declarations the script language finds
#     (in the module script and the instance script alike);
#   a top-level const -> constant, let or var -> variable, export let -> field (a prop); a const
#     bound to a function or arrow function stays a function;
# A method written in object shorthand (get x() {}, onClick() {}) or a function-valued property is a
#   method only in the component's own options object; in an object that is an argument of a call
#   (createTable({ get data() {} }), computed(() => ({ f() {} }))) or is bound to a name it is not
#   (Table.svelte). Methods of a class are always methods.
# Not definitions: anything inside a function body, imports, $: statements that assign nothing,
# $effect calls, a snippet inside a comment or an expression string.
